scenes.name: THE ARRIVAL

scenes.name: BUILDING A NEW LIFE
scenes.camera: a slow truck across the settlement as houses rise, frame by frame

scenes.name: THE FINAL MYSTERY

lines.text: An entire colony vanished... and left behind one mysterious word.
lines.tts: An entire colony vanished... and left behind one mysterious word.

lines.text: July, 1587. More than a hundred English men, women and children landed on Roanoke Island.
lines.tts: July, fifteen eighty-seven. More than a hundred English men, women and children landed on Roanoke Island.

lines.text: They rebuilt an abandoned fort's houses. But food was short, and clashes with local peoples turned deadly.
lines.tts: They rebuilt an abandoned fort's houses. But food was short, and clashes with local peoples turned deadly.

lines.text: Governor John White sailed to England for supplies... leaving his newborn granddaughter, Virginia Dare.
lines.tts: Governor John White sailed to England for supplies... leaving his newborn granddaughter, Virginia Dare.

lines.text: But England was at war with Spain. Ships were held back to fight the Armada. One year became three.
lines.tts: But England was at war with Spain. Ships were held back to fight the Armada. One year... became three.

lines.text: August, 1590. White finally returned. At night, his men sounded a trumpet and sang English songs. No one answered.
lines.tts: August, fifteen ninety. White finally returned. At night, his men sounded a trumpet, and sang English songs. No one answered.

lines.text: The houses were gone. Carved into a post, one word: CROATOAN. And no cross, their agreed sign of distress.
lines.tts: The houses were gone. Carved into a post, one word: Croatoan. And no cross, their agreed sign of distress.

lines.text: Croatoan was a nearby island, home to allies. Did they go there? Join Native communities? No one has proven it.
lines.tts: Croatoan was a nearby island, home to allies. Did they go there? Join Native communities? No one has proven it.

lines.text: Archaeologists are still searching... and the forest keeps its secret.
lines.tts: Archaeologists are still searching... and the forest, keeps its secret.
